blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources, together with 2) BiHOI, a multi-view dataset of 1,575 sequences spanning 229 objects and emphasizing sustained bimanual interaction, where reconstructed interactions are retargeted into robot references. DONIC combines proximal policy optimization with behavioral cloning in a feedback loop that recycles verified successful executions into training demonstrations. An object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback while supervising each hand according to its reference contact role. Clip-Centered Advantages remove reference-dependent advantage offsets while preserving within-trajectory differences. Together, these designs enable one single policy to learn coordinated manipulation across heterogeneous references. Without finetuning, a single checkpoint achieves 86.79% success on unseen trajectories of training objects and 57.32% on held-out objects, surpassing the state-of-the-art bimanual tracking baselines by 77.36 and 45.73 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 尽管最近在离子参考跟踪方面取得了进展,但现有的模型主要侧重于单手操纵和有限的相互作用范围,使得现实生活中常见的双手离子行为得不到解决. 缺乏内容丰富的双人操作数据以及协调接触日益复杂,使得开发通用双人跟踪器尤其具有挑战性。 因此,我们介绍1)DONIC,这是第一个跨行动类别和人类运动源联合培训的通用双人追踪器,以及2)波黑OI,一个由1,575个序列组成的多视图数据集,覆盖了229个物体,强调持续的双人互动,其中重建的互动被重新锁定为机器人参考。 DONIC将近效政策优化与行为克隆结合在一个反馈回路中,将已核实的死刑成功执行回收到训练演示中. 以对象为主的单手奖励保持对象运动反馈,同时按照参考接触作用监督每只手. 以 Clip-Clecting 为主的优势消除了依赖参考的优势相抵消,同时保留了内向差异. 这些设计合在一起,使单一政策能够学习不同参考文献的协调操作。 没有微调,一个检查站在未见的训练物体轨道上取得了86.79%的成功,在被扣留物体上取得了57.32%的成功,比最新双人追踪基线高出77.36和45.73个百分点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dexterous manipulation supports household assistance, industrial assembly, and assistive care. Unlike gripper-based manipulation, it requires precise coordination of finger motions and changing hand–object contacts to grasp, reorient, and reposition objects [ 28 , 2 , 8 , 33 ] . Generalizing across objects and behaviors is challenging, especially when human demonstrations must be retargeted to robot hands with different kinematics [ 26 , 19 , 38 ] . Simulation-ready objects [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] and synthetic trajectories [ 12 , 40 ] enable large-scale interaction data, but may not fully capture natural human manipulation. Recent trackers therefore learn from human hand–object motion [ 19 , 38 , 1 ] , yet remain largely limited to single-hand tasks. Many everyday tasks instead require asymmetric bimanual coordination: one hand stabilizes an object while the other opens, rotates, or repositions it [ 9 , 41 , 43 ] . This motivates a generalist bimanual reference tracker that learns from diverse human motion to control different objects and tasks with one policy.
blocks.zh: Dexterous操纵支持家庭援助、工业组装和辅助护理。 与以握手为主的操纵不同,它要求精确协调手指运动和改变手-物体接触,以便抓住、调整和重新定位物体[28、2、8、33]。 跨物体和行为的一般化具有挑战性,特别是在人类的示威必须重新针对具有不同运动力的机器人手[26,19,38]. 模拟准备对象[4,5,6]和合成轨迹[12,40]能够实现大规模交互数据,但可能不能完全捕捉人类的自然操纵. 因此,最近的追踪器从人类手-物体运动[19、38、1]中学习,但基本上仍然限于单手任务。 相反,许多日常任务需要不对称的双人协调:一只手稳定一个对象,而另一只手则打开,旋转,或重新定位它[9,41,43]. 这激励了一个通用的双人参考追踪器,从不同的人类运动中学习,用一种政策控制不同的物体和任务.

blocks.en: Developing such a tracker poses two challenges. First, public datasets include bimanual manipulation [ 9 , 41 , 20 , 10 ] , but fully tracked hand–object sequences with sustained two-hand contact remain scarce, limiting the available coordination patterns. Second, a shared policy must learn trajectories with changing hand roles and contact timing. Hand-pose accuracy alone does not ensure successful object manipulation, while requiring both hands to satisfy contact conditions can mask one hand’s progress. Unequal clip difficulty also creates advantage offsets that can weaken updates for useful actions in harder sequences. Shared training therefore needs feedback grounded in object motion and each hand’s reference contacts, alongside advantages that preserve differences among transitions within each clip.
blocks.zh: 开发这样一个跟踪器构成两个挑战。 首先,公共数据集包括双人操纵[9,41,20,10],但完全跟踪的手-两手持续接触的对象序列仍然很少,限制了现有的协调模式. 第二,共同政策必须学习改变手部作用和接触时间的轨迹。 单凭手握精度并不能确保物体的操纵成功,同时要求双手满足接触条件可以掩盖一只手的进步. 不平等的剪辑难度也产生优势抵消,可以削弱在更硬的序列中有用行动的更新. 因此,共享培训需要基于物体运动和每一手的参考联系的反馈,同时需要保持每一片段内过渡之间差异的优势。

blocks.en: We address these challenges with DONIC , a generalist bimanual reference tracker, and BiHOI, a multi-view hand–object interaction dataset. BiHOI contains 1,575 1{,}575 sequences spanning 229 229 objects and 14.77 14.77 hours, captured from 32 32 calibrated RGB views. It covers symmetric manipulation and asymmetric coordination. We reconstruct both hands and the object, then retarget hand motion to robot references paired with the object trajectory. Combined with public references, BiHOI broadens the training objects and coordination patterns. DONIC learns one policy for both hands through proximal policy optimization (PPO) [ 31 ] and behavioral cloning (BC) on verified demonstrations. Trajectory-specific policies optimize screened references, while successful shared-policy executions are verified and reused. At inference, one checkpoint tracks new references without further training. Our object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback and supervises each hand’s reference contacts, including asynchronous engagement. Our Clip-Centered Advantages (CCA) subtract each clip’s mean estimated advantage before PPO updates, removing clip-dependent offsets while preserving within-clip differences. On held-out trajectories and objects from public datasets, DONIC exceeds the stronger bimanual baseline by 77.36 77.36 and 45.73 45.73 percentage points in success rate, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们用通用的双向参考跟踪器DONIC和多视图手-对象交互数据集波黑OI来应对这些挑战。 波黑OI包含1,575个1{,}575个序列,它们跨越229,229个物体和14.77个14.77小时,从32个校准的RGB视图中捕获. 它涵盖了对称操控和不对称协调. 我们重建了手和物体, 然后把手运动重新瞄准机器人参考物 与物体的轨迹对齐。 波黑国际合作署与公众参考资料相结合,扩大了培训对象和协调模式。 DONIC通过近缘政策优化(PPO)[31]和经核实的演示上的行为克隆(BC),为双方学习一个政策. 轨迹特定政策优化了筛选参考,而成功的共享政策处决则得到核实和重复使用。 推断,一个检查站在未经进一步培训的情况下跟踪新的参考资料。 我们的面向对象的单手奖励保持对象运动反馈,并监督每个手的参考联系人,包括同步接触. 我们的Clip-Center优势(CCA)在PPO更新前减去每个剪辑的平均值估计优势,去除依赖剪辑的抵消,同时保留剪辑内的差异. 在公共数据集的搁置轨迹和物体上,DONIC分别比较强的双人基准高出77.36 77.36和45.73成功率45.73个百分点.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • To our knowledge, DONIC is the first bimanual reference tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human motion datasets; a single checkpoint is evaluated on unseen trajectories and objects without fine-tuning. • We introduce BiHOI, a multi-view hand-object interaction dataset emphasizing coordinated bimanual manipulation, and reconstruct its recordings into robot motion references. • We propose an object-centered per-hand reward and CCA to support joint PPO training across bimanual references with different contact roles and difficulty. • On our two public-data evaluation splits, DONIC outperforms bimanual adaptations of DexTrack and Dexplore in success rate and completion, reaching 86.79 % 86.79\% and 57.32 % 57.32\% success on unseen trajectories and objects, respectively.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 据我们所知,DONIC是第一台跨业务类别和人类运动数据集联合培训的双人参考跟踪器;一个检查点在不经过微调的情况下对看不见的轨迹和物体进行评价。 我们介绍波黑OI,一个多视图的手物交互数据集,强调协调双人操纵,并将其录音重建为机器人运动参考。 我们提议采用以对象为中心的单手奖励和共同国家评析,支持对具有不同接触作用和困难的双手参考进行共同的PPO培训。 在我们的两次公共数据评估中,DONIC在成功率和完成率上超越了DexTrack和Dexplore的双人调整,分别达到86.79%、86.79%和57.32%。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human trajectories provide motion targets, but retargeting alone cannot ensure successful contact. Sequence-specific policies commonly use reinforcement learning to correct retargeted motion. ManipTrans [ 15 ] reuses a general hand-motion imitator but learns a task-specific residual policy for interaction. DexMachina [ 23 ] learns from individual demonstrations by gradually removing virtual object assistance. CHORD [ 44 ] guides sequence-specific learning through contact-wrench matching, while ConTrack [ 17 ] trains one policy per clip with an adaptive balance between object tracking and motion fidelity. We instead learn one generalist bimanual policy that tracks diverse references without per-reference training or fine-tuning at test time.
blocks.zh: 人类的轨迹提供了运动目标,但单靠重新瞄准无法确保成功接触. 序列特定政策通常使用强化学习来纠正重定向运动. ManipTrans [15] 重用一般的手动仿真器,但学习任务特定的剩余策略进行互动. DexMachina [23] 通过逐步取消虚拟对象援助从个人演示中学习. CHORD [44]通过接触扳手比对来指导序列特定学习,而ConTrack [17] 则每个剪辑执行一个政策,在物体跟踪和运动忠贞之间保持适应性平衡. 相反,我们学习了一个通俗主义的双行政策,在试验时不进行参考培训或微调,而跟踪各种参考资料。

blocks.en: Generalist policies share knowledge across objects, motions, or skills, predominantly in single-hand settings. UniDexGrasp++ [ 33 ] generalizes grasping across object geometries, UniCross [ 42 ] unifies multiple manipulation skills, and ArtManip [ 39 ] learns category-level articulated in-hand manipulation. For reference tracking, DexTrack [ 19 ] combines reinforcement learning with demonstrations mined by trajectory-specific controllers. Dexplore [ 38 ] expands exploration around reference motions, while AdaDexTrack [ 1 ] combines specialist distillation with online reference modulation. Bimanual tracking must coordinate complementary hand roles and contact timing. Existing work explores narrower generalization: BiDexHD [ 43 ] distills teachers into a separate trajectory-conditioned policy for each operation category and evaluates new object–tool combinations and instances within categories; PhysGraph [ 16 ] transfers task-trained policies to new tool and object geometries. We jointly train one bimanual reference tracker across operation categories and human motion datasets, and evaluate it on unseen trajectories and objects without fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 一般政策主要在单手环境下,在对象、动作或技能之间分享知识。 UniDexGrasp++ [33] 概括了跨越对象几何的把握, UniCross [42] 统一了多种操控技能,ArtManip [39] 学习了类别级的手动操控. 为参考跟踪,DexTrack [19] 结合了强化学习和由特定轨迹控制器挖掘的演示. Dexplore [38] 扩展了围绕参考动议的探索,而AdaDexTrack [1] 结合了专家蒸馏和在线参考调制. 双人跟踪必须协调互补的手角色和接触时间. 现有工作探索更狭义的概括: BiDexHD [43] 将教师分解为每个操作类别有轨迹限制的单独政策,并在类别内评价新的对象-工具组合和实例; PhysGraph [16] 将任务训练政策转移到新的工具和对象几何. 我们联合训练一个双人参考跟踪器, 跨操作类别和人类运动数据集, 并用看不见的轨迹和物体来评价它, 没有微调。

blocks.en: GRAB [ 32 ] records whole-body grasping with detailed contact information, while ARCTIC [ 9 ] captures the coupled motion of two hands and articulated objects. OakInk2 [ 41 ] organizes bimanual manipulation into primitive and complex tasks, and TACO [ 20 ] covers diverse tool–action–object compositions. GigaHands [ 10 ] further expands the scale and diversity of bimanual activities with language annotations. Complementing these motion collections, H2O [ 13 ] and HOI4D [ 21 ] support egocentric interaction understanding, while HOT3D [ 3 ] and HO-Cap [ 34 ] provide recordings and annotations for hand–object reconstruction and tracking. Capture and annotation conventions differ, and human kinematics do not ensure executable robot actions. We harmonize, retarget, and screen zero-residual feasibility to form a common bimanual reference pool for joint training.
blocks.zh: GRAB[32]记录了全身掌握了详细的联系信息,而ARCTIC[9]记录了两只手的偶联运动和清晰的物体. OakInk2 [41] 组织双人操纵,以完成原始和复杂的任务,TACO [20] 涵盖了多种工具–动作–对象组成. GigaHands [10] 进一步扩展双人活动的规模和多样性,并附有语言说明. 作为这些运动集合的补充,H2O [13] 和HOI4D [21]支持以自我为中心的相互作用理解,而HOT3D [3]和HO-Cap [34]则为手-物体的重建和跟踪提供录音和说明. 捕捉和注释惯例不同,人类动能学不能确保可执行的机器人行动. 我们统一、重新定位和筛选零剩余的可行性,以形成共同的双人参考库,供联合培训使用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Annotation and Reference Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 注释和参考建筑

blocks.en:
We reconstruct metric hand–object trajectories from synchronized RGB recordings.
SAM3 provides object masks [ 7 ] , while multi-view Depth Anything 3 provides spatially consistent depth that we align to metric scale using the calibrated camera extrinsics [ 18 ] .
MV-SAM3D reconstructs a canonical object mesh from first-frame views and masks [ 14 ] ; back-projected depth determines its physical scale.
FoundationPose then recovers 6-DoF object motion [ 37 ] , using multi-view pose consensus to handle occlusion and re-registration when consensus fails.
blocks.zh:
我们从同步的 RGB 记录中重建 rimal hand -object 轨迹 。
SAM3提供对象口罩[7],而多视深度Anything 3则提供空间一致的深度,我们使用校准的相机外观来配合度量尺度[18].
MV-SAM3D从第一帧视图和口罩重建一个犬形物体网格[14];后投影深度决定其物理尺度.
基金会 Pose 然后恢复过来了 6-DoF object movement [37] ,使用多视图表示共识,在协商一致失败时处理隔离和重新登记.

blocks.en:
For each participant, triangulated calibration keypoints are used to estimate metric hand scale and calibrate a participant-specific MANO shape.
WiLoR provides per-view hand observations [ 24 ] ; these observations are triangulated, temporally smoothed, and fitted with the MANO hand model [ 29 ] , with shape held fixed across the sequence.
Joint refinement against multi-view metric depth combines geometric alignment with reconstruction and temporal regularization, producing bimanual MANO parameters, a metric object mesh, and its 6-DoF trajectory in a common world frame.
Reconstruction and refinement details appear in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh:
对于每个参与者,使用三角校准键点来估计度量手尺度和校准一个参与者特定的MANO形状.
WiLOR提供per-view手观测[24];这些观测是三角的,时间性平滑的,并安装了MANO手型[29],形状固定在序列之间.
对照多视图度量深度的联合改进结合了几何与重建和时间规范化的结合,产生了双手动的MANO参数,一个度量对象网,及其在共同的世界框架内的6-DoF轨迹.

blocks.en:
We map the reconstructed human motion to the Wuji robot hands through frame-wise kinematic fitting, following standard retargeting practice [ 11 , 27 , 19 ] .
After wrist-frame alignment, we fit hand keypoints to robot links under joint limits, initializing and regularizing each frame against the preceding solution. Smoothing occurs only before retargeting. The resulting wrist and finger references are paired with the object trajectory.
blocks.zh:
我们按照标准重定向练习[11,27,19],通过帧式动能配置,将人类重建的运动图映射给武吉机器人手.
在手腕框对齐后,我们将手键点配合到联合限制下的机器人链路上,比照之前的解决方案初始化和规范化每个帧. 平滑只在重新瞄准之前发生. 由此产生的手腕和手指参考物与物体的轨迹成对.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: DONIC learns a generalist bimanual tracker across operation categories and human-data sources (Figure 2 ). Its object-centered per-hand reward supports complementary roles and asynchronous contacts while maintaining object-motion feedback. CCA removes reference-dependent offsets after generalized advantage estimation (GAE) [ 30 ] , preserving within-reference advantage differences.
blocks.zh: DONIC学习跨操作类别和人类数据来源的通用双人跟踪器(图2 )。 其以对象为中心的单手奖励支持互补作用和同步接触,同时保持对象运动反馈. 共同国家评析删除了通用优势估算(GAE)[30]后依赖参考的抵消,保留参考内优势差异.

blocks.en: 4.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务定义

blocks.en: Given a reference for two hands and an object, one policy controls both robot hands to reproduce the object motion through physical interaction. Following DexTrack [ 19 ] , training combines PPO with BC from executable demonstrations; the policy tracks unseen trajectories and objects without fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 4.4 Learning a Generalist from Verified Demonstrations
blocks.zh: 4.4 从经核实的示威中学习一名将军

blocks.en: Following DexTrack [ 19 ] , we alternate PPO+BC training with demonstration collection. PPO learns through simulated interaction, while BC supplies successful actions that shared exploration may struggle to discover. Trajectory-specific policies optimize references retained by replay screening; their verified rollouts form a demonstration library 𝒟 \mathcal{D} of observation–action pairs. As the generalist improves, its verified successes are added to 𝒟 \mathcal{D} for subsequent updates. All demonstrations come from training references.
blocks.zh: 追踪DexTrack [19],我们轮流PPO+BC训练与示范收集. PPO通过模拟互动学习,而BC则提供共享探索可能难以发现的成功动作. 轨迹特异性政策优化了通过重播筛选保留的引用;其经核实的推出形成了一个演示库 D\mathcal{D} 观察 - 动作配对. 随着通论者的改进,其经核实的成功被添加到 D\ mathcal{D} 以供后续更新. 所有示威活动都来自培训参考资料。

blocks.en: Demonstrations supply successful behavior, while CCA addresses unequal reference difficulty in PPO updates.
blocks.zh: 示范提供成功的行为,而CCA则在PPO更新中解决不平等的参考困难.

blocks.en: Shared PPO batches mix contact patterns and coordination demands. GAE combines temporally weighted value-prediction residuals, but unequal critic accuracy across references can leave clip-dependent offsets. Difficult clips may then receive consistently negative advantages despite relatively successful transitions. CCA removes this common offset while preserving within-clip differences.
blocks.zh: 共享的PPO批次混合了联系模式和协调需求. GAE结合了时间加权价值预测的剩余部分,但不同参考文献中不均匀的批评者准确性可能会留下依赖剪切的抵消. 尽管过渡相对成功,但困难的片段可能会获得持续的负面优势。 CCA在保留阴间差异的同时去除这个常见的抵消.

blocks.en: Groups are defined by reference identity rather than by environment instance or temporal phase, allowing parallel rollouts of the same reference to contribute to a common baseline. Unlike batch-wide centering, CCA removes an offset specific to each reference instead of applying one shared shift to all clips. We subtract only the group mean, without dividing by a per-clip standard deviation, preserving the scale of within-clip advantage differences. This adjustment acts on the policy’s learning signal; it does not modify the reward or the critic’s regression targets.

One DONIC checkpoint improves both held-out splits without fine-tuning (Table 2 ).
On unseen-traj , DONIC achieves 86.79 % 86.79\% SR and 67.62 % 67.62\% Comp, exceeding the stronger baseline, Dexplore-bi, by 77.36 77.36 and 39.75 39.75 percentage points, respectively.
On unseen-obj , it reaches 57.32 % 57.32\% SR and 54.69 % 54.69\% Comp, compared with 11.59 % 11.59\% and 26.37 % 26.37\% for Dexplore-bi.
The gains extend to hand tracking: wrist translation error decreases from 21.88 21.88 to 3.96 3.96 cm on unseen trajectories and from 19.46 19.46 to 4.58 4.58 cm on unseen objects. DONIC reduces all reported errors relative to both baselines except object rotation on unseen-traj .
Because SR and Comp require both hands to meet the tracking criteria, these improvements reflect successful bimanual execution rather than accuracy from only one hand.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion, Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented DONIC , a generalist bimanual tracker, and BiHOI, a multi-view bimanual interaction dataset. Object-centered per-hand rewards and CCA support iterative PPO+BC training, yielding one checkpoint that generalizes to unseen trajectories and objects without fine-tuning and substantially outperforms adapted baselines. Ablations support both learning signals and the benefit of additional BiHOI data.
However, our quantitative evaluation focuses on simulated single-object interactions and relies on reconstructed, retargeted motion references.
We aim to extend DONIC to longer-horizon and multi-object manipulation, evaluate on an independent benchmark, and investigate transfer to physical bimanual systems.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了DONIC, 一个通用的双人追踪器, 和波黑OI, 一个多视图双人互动数据集。 以对象为主的每手奖励和共同国家评估支持迭代的PPO+BC培训,产生一个检查站,即通达看不见的轨迹和物体,而不进行微调,并且大大超出经过调整的基线。 差距既支持学习信号,也支持波黑OI额外数据的好处。
然而,我们的定量评价侧重于模拟的单对象相互作用,并依赖于重建的,重定向的运动引用.
我们的目标是将DONIC扩展至更远的视野和多物体的操纵,根据独立的基准进行评估,并调查向物理双人系统转移的情况。

blocks.en: Human demonstrations provide motion targets but do not directly specify robot actions: differences in hand kinematics and simulated contact can make a kinematically plausible reference physically difficult to execute. Reference-based trackers address this gap through closed-loop control. DexTrack [ 19 ] combines trajectory-specific demonstration generation with generalist learning; Dexplore [ 38 ] expands exploration around reference motions; and AdaDexTrack [ 1 ] combines specialist distillation with reference modulation. Our reference-conditioned action interface and iterative reinforcement–imitation learning loop build on this line of work. Our contributions within that loop are the object-centered per-hand reward and Clip-Centered Advantages (CCA), designed for shared bimanual tracking across heterogeneous references.
blocks.zh: 人类演示提供了运动目标,但并未直接指定机器人动作:手动运动和模拟接触的差异会使得运动上可信的参照物在物理上难以执行. 基于参考的跟踪器通过闭路控制解决这一缺口. DexTrack [19] 将特定轨迹的演示生成与通论学习相结合;Dexplore [38] 围绕参考运动扩展探索;AdaDexTrack [1] 将专家蒸馏与参考调制相结合. 我们的参考条件行动接口和迭代强化-模拟学习循环都建立在这项工作的基础之上。 我们在这个圈子内的贡献是以对象为中心的单手奖励和Clip-Center Advances(CCA),旨在共享双手跟踪不同参考文献。

blocks.en: Generalization across grasped objects, manipulation skills, and complete reference trajectories imposes different requirements. UniDexGrasp++ [ 33 ] studies generalizable dexterous grasping, while BiDexHD [ 43 ] learns trajectory-conditioned bimanual policies within operation categories. Our controller is jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources. We evaluate new trajectories of training objects and trajectories involving held-out objects with the same checkpoint. These two splits test reference and object generalization; they do not, by themselves, establish generalization to held-out operation categories or arbitrary manipulation goals.
blocks.zh: 跨越抓取对象的通俗化,操纵技巧,以及完整的参考轨迹,都提出了不同的要求. UniDexGrasp++ [33] 研究一般的可解性抓取,而BiDexHD [43] 在操作类别中学习有轨迹条件的双人政策. 我们的管制员接受跨行动类别和人类运动源的联合训练。 我们评价训练物体的新轨迹和在同一个检查站被扣留物体的轨迹。 这两个拆分测试参考和对象概括;它们本身并不确立被搁置操作类别或任意操纵目标的概括.

blocks.en: GRAB, GigaHands, OakInk2, TACO, and H2O provide complementary sources of hand–object interaction [ 32 , 10 , 41 , 20 , 13 ] . HOI4D and HO-Cap further broaden capture settings and annotation tools [ 21 , 34 ] . Our comparison distinguishes the inventory of a source dataset from the subset retained for robot training. A clip enters our bimanual pool only if the required hand and object tracks are available and both hands contact the object at some point. This allows sequential as well as simultaneous hand participation. BiHOI complements these sources with a higher measured proportion of simultaneous bimanual contact in the analyzed recordings.

blocks.en: The reconstruction pipeline uses learned image predictions to initialize geometry, then calibrated multi-view observations to recover physical scale and temporal consistency. Its five stages are mask/depth extraction, object reconstruction and tracking, participant-specific hand calibration, hand-motion reconstruction, and joint refinement. Figure S1 summarizes the complete calibrated multi-view reconstruction and annotation pipeline.

MANO fitting combines filtered metric joints, multi-view image keypoints, and calibrated projections, keeping hand shape fixed while estimating pose and global motion.

blocks.en: Retargeting follows position-based kinematic fitting [ 11 , 27 , 19 ] . For each frame and hand, fifteen target entries are fitted to corresponding Wuji-hand links: five MANO fingertips (indices 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 , 20 4,8,12,16,20 ), five additional finger keypoints ( 3 , 7 , 11 , 15 , 19 3,7,11,15,19 ), and the wrist (index 0 0 ) repeated five times. The fit uses SmoothL1 position loss with transition scale 0.02 0.02 m and NLopt optimization with robot joint limits as hard bounds. The implementation uses a joint-limit tolerance of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , initializes from the preceding frame’s solution, and uses inter-frame regularization parameter norm_delta = 4 × 10 − 3 =4\times 10^{-3} .

blocks.en: Open-loop replay with zero policy correction classifies each candidate reference into six outcomes: immediate object loss (A), object ejection (B), contact without lifting (C), partial execution (D), tracking with an incorrect release or ending (E), and complete execution (F). Categories A and B are excluded, whereas C–F remain available for closed-loop training. Category C is retained because failure to lift under reference-only replay does not rule out recovery by feedback control. Screening determines reference eligibility; it is distinct from the verification used to admit executable demonstrations.

blocks.en: Following DexTrack’s reinforcement–imitation loop [ 19 ] , specialist training covers all references retained by replay screening. Each trajectory-specific controller seeks an executable realization of its reference; successful rollouts are exported and replay-verified before admission to the demonstration library. The shared controller is periodically evaluated on the training pool, and its verified successes supplement the library for subsequent PPO+BC updates. Held-out references are excluded throughout.

blocks.en: D.3 Baseline Implementations and Comparison Scope
blocks.zh: D.3 基线执行情况和比较范围

blocks.en: We use DexTrack’s released specialist–distillation pipeline [ 19 ] , adapting its observation and action interfaces to two Wuji hands. Trajectory-specific controllers produce demonstrations for generalist distillation, and evaluation follows the released per-trajectory protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们使用DexTrack释放的专家—蒸馏管道[19], 轨迹特定控制器为通用式蒸馏产生演示,评价遵循所释放的每轨协议.

blocks.en: We run the released Dexplore code [ 38 ] with two-hand observation and action interfaces, retaining its original reward and reference-scoped exploration.
blocks.zh: 我们运行已发布的Dexplore代码[38],并有双手观察和动作界面,保留其最初的奖励和参考范围探索.

blocks.en: All methods use Isaac Gym, two Wuji hands, the same public training clips, and the same held-out split identities. Tracking errors are computed using the bimanual metrics defined in Section D.2 . All 164 unseen-object and 53 unseen-trajectory clips are included.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都使用Isaac Gym,两只武吉手,相同的公共训练剪辑,以及相同的被搁置的分裂身份. 跟踪错误是使用D.2节界定的双人衡量标准计算的。 所有164个隐形物体和53个隐形弹夹都包括在内。

blocks.zh: D.4 定义和补充数据

blocks.en: The learning-signal ablations in the main table examine CCA and object-centered supervision. The w/o CCA variant removes the clip-wise mean subtraction after GAE. The w/o contact gate variant disables DEXPLORE_CG_REWARD, replacing the simulated force-and-distance contact proxy by the force-only test 𝟏 [ f i , t h > 0.5 ] \mathbf{1}[f_{i,t}^{h}>0.5] . It removes the 3 3 cm contact-ownership condition, not the object-motion reward. Reward coefficients β \beta and fixed hand weights are unchanged; they are not renormalized. Ours+BiHOI tests the effect of adding all 1,575 1{,}575 captured sequences to the public pool while retaining the same public evaluation splits.

blocks.en: Removing either learning signal lowers both SR and Comp on both splits. CCA removal also increases all five tracking errors; removing the contact gate improves some individual errors but reduces joint bimanual success. Adding BiHOI improves all seven metrics on both splits, reaching SR of 88.68 % 88.68\% and 59.76 % 59.76\% on unseen trajectories and objects, respectively. Unseen-object translation error falls from 15.74 15.74 to 13.96 13.96 cm.
blocks.zh: 清除学习信号会降低SR和Comp两个分数。 CCA移除也增加了所有五个跟踪错误;移除接触门会改进一些个别错误,但会减少联合双人成功. 增加波黑OI可以改善两个分块上的所有七个度量,分别达到88.68%、88.68%和59.76%。 不明对象翻译错误从15.74 15.74降至13.96 13.96 cm.

blocks.en: D.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: D.6 限制

blocks.en: The quantitative experiments evaluate reference-conditioned, single-rigid-object tracking in simulation. Unconstrained goal-conditioned manipulation and held-out operation-category generalization are outside this evaluation. The capture inventory includes broader object types than the rigid-object representation described in Section B.1 . Contact supervision uses a net-force/proximity proxy, and reconstruction has no explicit contact or collision loss.
blocks.zh: 定量实验在模拟中评价了参照条件的单刚物体跟踪. 不受限制的有目标条件的操纵和被搁置的操作类别一般化不属于本评价的范围。 捕捉清单包括比B.1节所述刚性物体表示更广泛的物体类型。 联系监管使用净力/近距离代用,重建没有明显的接触或碰撞损失.
